messages.author: e83d54ec65b5b8e6
messages.subject: legend position and size
parts:
I am doing a series of plots (geom_point) for an animation. I am using the size aesthetics, and I am creating
a legend for it. The number of items on the legend list changes during the animation (larger points come in later), 
but I do not want the legend to "hop around". T
he best solution would be to have the full legend from the very beginning,
while there are not large points yet on the plot, but the corresponding legend item nevertheless is displayed.
The second best solution would be that the upper left position of the legend is fixed.
Using something like
theme(legend.position=c(0.1,0.7))
does not solve the problem since the coordinates indicate the center of the legend,
and I need to place the top left corner of the legend in that case.

Is there a solution for my problem?

messages.author: afa3a78132320260
messages.subject: Re: legend position and size
parts:
You don't have a reproducible example, but I think you can use scale_size() with the limits argument to create the same scale for all your plots.

Hth,
W.

messages.subject: Re: legend position and size
parts:
I managed to solve the problem by using the breaks and limits parametes of scale_size_continuous explicitly.
Some fidding was necessary, but then I always had all the legend items even for not yex existing data points.
